result.reason: The operative language does not reach either playbook position. It changes the default to Type I and preserves Customer rights in data, but does not expressly assign ownership of deliverables/work product to Customer or establish the required treatment of embedded pre-existing IBM IP. Nor does it implement the fallback: the Type II licence remains limited to Customer's US-based Enterprise and lacks express perpetual, modification, and sublicensing rights. The margin comment does not cure these omissions. The unnecessary clause reordering and use of undefined “Content” also reduce precision, although unrelated commercial terms are largely preserved.
